lines.zh: 我四脚着地慢慢走，背甲很沉。
lines.en: I walk slowly on four legs, my armor heavy.

lines.zh: 我低着头，一路嗅着地面。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, scenting the ground.

lines.zh: 我走得不高，肚子快贴地。
lines.en: I keep low, my belly near the ground.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里穿过去，背甲刮着叶子。
lines.en: I push through the ferns, armor scraping leaves.
I move slowly along the lake shore.

lines.zh: 我停一下，用爪子扒了扒土。
lines.en: I stop and scratch at the soil.
I go around a boulder.

lines.zh: 我的步子和身体比起来很快。
lines.en: I move quicker than my body suggests.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看看后面。
lines.en: I glance behind me as I go.

lines.zh: 我从火山灰上走过，留下深印。
lines.en: I cross the ash and leave deep prints.
I head for the trees.

lines.zh: 我低着头，把落叶拱到一边。
lines.en: I lower my head and push the leaf litter aside.
I crush a few dry twigs.

lines.zh: 我沿着一道浅沟往前走。
lines.en: I follow a shallow gully.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，往水边去。
lines.en: I change direction toward the water.

lines.zh: 我走得不稳，可我从不停。
lines.en: My gait is unsteady, but I never stop.
I lie with my head on the ground.

lines.zh: 我背上的甲片一片叠一片。
lines.en: The plates on my back overlap.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有东西靠近。
lines.en: I am listening for anything approaching.
My prints are in the ash.

lines.zh: 我用前爪刨了刨土，翻出点东西。
lines.en: I scratch the soil and turn something up.
I do not move unless I must.
These ferns are enough cover.

lines.zh: 我挖开火山灰，看看底下。
lines.en: I dig through the ash to see what lies under.

lines.zh: 我呼吸很轻，怕吵醒幼崽。
lines.en: I breathe softly so I do not wake the young.
There is ash on my back.
My armored back hugs the volcanic ash.
I am waiting for the little one to return.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，火山灰落在背上。
lines.en: I blink as ash settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在温热的石上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a warm stone.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看你，脖子很短。
lines.en: I raise my head at you, my neck very short.
I shifted away one small step.
My armor is thick; I am not afraid of you.

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，又低下头。
lines.en: I watch you a while, then lower my head.
You are standing on my prints.
I draw my foreclaw back.
Do not ring me in; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，爪子还沾着火山灰。
lines.en: I look up at you, volcanic ash still on my claws.
I shift aside.
I tuck my head in a little.
I retreat to the edge of the ferns.
My leg trembles once.

lines.zh: 我这身甲，是白垩纪给的。
lines.en: This armor came with the Cretaceous.
I guard what is behind me.
I sag to one side.
I slowly settle back down.
Is that fern or leaf?
I take two steps that way.
I chew it slowly, bite by bite.
That will not take long to chew.
I lower my head to root at it.
Shoots like these are my favorite.
I root out two more pieces.
The little one beside me wants some too.
You hit me; my armor is hard.
The shove moves me half a step.
I shove back with my shoulder.
I hardly feel that.
I lower myself and hold.
You have touched my back plates.
I turn my body aside to let you past.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我们蹬起来了。
lines.en: We have kicked up the ash.
Do not crush the little ones.
I move back to where I was.
We stay close, very quietly.
I dig out a hollow for a nest.
In these days I keep watch.

lines.zh: 小的出来之后，我更不走开。
lines.en: Once the little ones come, I leave even less.
We walk one behind the other.
I stand in front of her.

lines.zh: 我低低叫了一声，蹭蹭你。
lines.en: I give a low call and nuzzle you.
The soil at the nest is fresh.

lines.zh: 我们把这窝看得比什么都重。
lines.en: We value this nest above all.
I take it and chew.
This one I cannot get down.

lines.zh: 它埋在土里，我扒出来了。
lines.en: It was buried in the soil; I dug it out.
I push it to the small one.
This is too hard for my teeth.
This thing throws back light.
I sniff and set it down.
I scrape it aside with my claws.
I raise my head and look that way.
I move in front of the little one.
I crouch low, my plates to the ground.
That sound is not right.
I open my mouth and call.
I will not lunge first.
The little ones have moved behind me.
I have blocked that path.
My claws bite into the soil.
I have planted this step.
I stay between them and it.
I am not fast, but I do not back off.
It has to get past me first.
I call low to warn it off.
I give not one step.
My armored back faces it.
The little ones are behind me, still.
It is still closing in.
Then I hold here.
I drive my armored back into it.
I reared up and brought my forefeet down.
That butt went wide.
I bite its leg.
I shoulder it aside.
I do not chase; I hold position.
I rear up and block again.
I throw my whole armored body at it.
If it pulls back, I stop.
I kick it away with a hind leg.
A line of prints appears in the ash.
Ash still lies on my armor.
I stop at the lake shore.
I scratch at the soil first.

lines.zh: 火山灰铺了一地，正合适。
lines.en: Volcanic ash all around—just right.
A little one follows me.
I raise my head toward the trees.
This regrown wood is decent.
I cross the clearing slowly.

lines.zh: 我找到了能藏身的地方。
lines.en: I have found somewhere to hide.
I stop under a tree.

lines.zh: 我把背甲上的灰抖了抖。
lines.en: I shake the ash off my armor.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，我往湿土里钻。
lines.en: Fire bakes my armor; I dig into damp soil.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，甲片磕得很响。
lines.en: I land hard and my plates clatter.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的头，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: Water covers my head; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我翻了过来，四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto my back.
Something glances off my armor.
Some force presses me to the ground.
Hunger leaves me too weak to dig.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的甲上，整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my armor and I go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我扒不到东西。
lines.en: There is no soil and my claws find nothing.
